πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. sg.
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παρὲκ: παρέκ — out past, beyond; prep., epic (= παρά + ἐκ), + acc. or gen.: ’out past (the mind)’
πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πλευράς: πλευρά — side, rib; fem. acc. pl.: ’the sides’
πλησίοι: πλησίος — near, close by; adj., masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’close beside’
πλῆτο: πελάζω — bring near; mid./pass. draw near, come to; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented: ’was brought to’ (+ dat.) · also πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic: ’was filled’ (+ gen.)

πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)

προτέρων: πρότερος — earlier, former; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’of earlier (men)’
πυκναὶ: πυκνός — thick, close-set; fem. nom. pl.: ’close-packed’

πόδεσσι: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ποσί)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πύματον: πύματος — last, final; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δρόμον: ’last’ (πύματον δρόμον ’the last stretch’)
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)

σήμηνε: σημαίνω — mark out, give a sign, signal; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐσήμηνε): ’marked out’
σπεύδοντι: σπεύδω — hurry, press on; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one who hurries’

στιβαρῇσιν: στιβαρός — sturdy, strong, stout; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (of hands)

σφίσι: σφεῖς — they; dat. pl., epic σφίσι, often reflexive: ’to/for themselves’

τέκτων: τέκτων — craftsman, worker in wood, horn or metal; masc. nom. sg.
τέλεον: τέλεος — complete, final; masc. acc. sg., epic form (= Attic τέλειον), agreeing with δρόμον: ’finishing’
τέρματ: τέρμα — boundary-mark, turning-post, goal, end-post; neut. acc. pl., elided (τέρματ’ = τέρματα)
τέτατο: τείνω — stretch, extend; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
τίον: τίω — honour, value; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔτιον): ’they honoured’

τανύσσῃ: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic τανύσῃ): ’stretches’
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.

τούς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’, accented before the enclitic γε · also relative, masc. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic μοι: ’whom’
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’of this man’

τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod (three-footed cauldron, a prize); masc. gen. sg., after περί: ’for a tripod’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the tripod’
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; neut. acc. sg., adverbial with the article (τὸ τρίτον): ’the third time’

τυχών: τυγχάνω — hit the mark, happen upon, chance; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’hitting the mark, having hit’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τύπτε: τύπτω — strike, beat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτυπτε): ’kept beating’

τῖον: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔτῑον): ’honoured’ · also impf. 1 sg. act., unaugmented: ’I honoured’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)

φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φασ: φημί — say; pres. 3 pl., elided (φασ’ = φασί): ’they say’
φθάμενος: φθάνω — come first, forestall; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φθάς): ’getting in first’
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)

ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’grievous’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’hard (to tell)’ (ἀργαλέον … ἀγορεῦσαι ’hard to tell’)
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, of silver; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν), agreeing with a neuter noun · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τελαμῶνα: ’silver’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’you Achaeans’
ἀχαιοῖς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἦγον): ’were leading’
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄεθλα: ἄεθλον — prize, contest; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἆθλα): ’prizes’
ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), subject: τόδε φαίνετ’ ἄεθλον ’this contest appears’
ἄειρεν: ἀείρω (Attic αἴρω) — lift, raise; impf. 3 sg., epic: ’lifted’
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl.: ’the other (things)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’some’ (ἄλλα μὲν … πολλὰ δὲ ’some … many’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’ · also dual, of two things: ’both (hands)’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἐλαφρά: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; neut. acc. pl., predicate with γυῖα: ’light’
ἐλαφρότατος: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’lightest’
ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass, prevail; impf. 3 sg.: ’won, prevailed’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — backward, behind, to the rear; adv. (of time, ’hereafter’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’)
ἐπίρροθος: ἐπίρροθος — helper, ally; masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἐπίστατο: ἐπίσταμαι — know, know how to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἠπίστατο)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐριμύκων: ἐρίμυκος — loud-bellowing (ἐρι- intensive + μυκάομαι ’bellow’); adj. (2 endings), masc. gen. pl., agreeing with βοῶν
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐϋζώνοιο: ἐΰζωνος — well-girdled; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), two-ending adj. with γυναικός
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑτάροιο: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of cause after a verb of anger · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of cause after ἄχος: ’for the comrade’ (ἄχος … ἑτάροιο ’grief for the comrade’) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, dependent on χερσί: ’of the companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, with ὀστέα: ’of the companion’ (ἑτάροιο ὀστέα ’the companion’s bones’)
ἔβαλ: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔβαλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck, hit’
ἔδωκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl. augmented (κ-aorist): ’they gave’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
ἔκφερ: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bring out; impf. 3 sg. act., elided and unaugmented (ἔκφερ’ = ἔκφερε = Attic ἐξέφερε)
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’ · also pres. inf. mid., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι), after φαίης: ’to be going’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)

ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’pleasing’ (φίλον καὶ ἡδύ ’dear and pleasing’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’) · also ’rather than’ after βούλομαι (βουλοίμην … ἢ … ’I would rather … than …’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. ἤραρε: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aor.): ’fitted together’
ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἰησονίδης: Ἰησονίδης — son of Jason; patronymic, masc. nom. sg.
ἱέσθην: ἵημι (mid.) — be eager, hasten, set oneself; impf. mid. 3 dual: ’were eager’
ἲς: ἴς — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἴχνια: ἴχνιον — footprint, track; neut. acc. pl.
ἶσ: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (ἶσ’ = ἶσα), + dat.: ’equally with’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς

ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’short’ (οὐκ ὀλίγον χρόνον ’no short time’)
ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
ὀϊλιάδης: Ὀϊλιάδης — son of Oileus (patronymic), the lesser Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
ὀϊλῆος: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)

ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὄρνυσθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rouse oneself, rise; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ὄρνυσθ’ = ὄρνυσθε): ’rouse yourselves’
ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’ · also ὅς τις in an indirect question, masc. acc. sg.: ’what’ (νόον ὅν τιν’ ἔχουσιν ’what mind they have’)

ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπέλυσε: ὑπολύω — loosen from beneath, unnerve; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὔμμ: σύ — you (pl.); elided epic ὔμμι (dat., Attic ὑμῖν): ’to you’ · also ὔμμε (acc., Attic ὑμᾶς): ’you’; the elision does not tell which
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὦνον: ὦνος — price, purchase price; masc. acc. sg., object of ἔδωκε: ’the price’
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέεν: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἔρρει): ’flowed’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥῖνάς: ῥίς — nose, nostril (distinct from ῥινός ’skin, hide’); fem. acc. pl.
